score.basis: the visual checks scored like the Visual bugs category of the genclass.dev page check (scan-score/4)

findings.target: article "Council approves the new library budget…"
findings.message: the page scrolls sideways on a 390 px viewport: body > div:nth-of-type(2) > article "Council approves the new library budget…" ends at 752 px (706 px too wide, a flex or grid item that cannot shrink).

measured.cause: a flex or grid item that cannot shrink

threshold.unit: px of scroll width beyond the client width
threshold.source: documentElement.scrollWidth > clientWidth + 1, the viewport not clipping, 1 s apart

findings.message: ad slots cover 43% of the page (threshold 30%, Better Ads ad density): 7 ad slots, 46% of the first screen and 43% of the page. Fix: use fewer or smaller ad units: under 30% of the page on phones, no sticky unit over 30% of the screen, and reserve each slot's space so it does not shift the page.

threshold.source: Coalition for Better Ads standards (ad density, large sticky ads, prestitials); ad slots named by id, class or ad attributes, or cross-site iframes at ad sizes (VISUAL.md 3.25)
